Two open-access books I've written for graduate-level quantitative methods courses.

## [Quantitative Foundations in Educational Research](/books/quant-foundations/)

A self-contained introduction to applied statistics for educational and social-science research: descriptive statistics, probability, sampling, inference, regression, and ANOVA. Developed for *ESC_PS 8850*, the master's-level methods course I taught at the University of Missouri. [Lecture slides →](/slides/quant-foundations/) · [Previous site →](https://zewang.netlify.app/books/quant-foundations/_book/)

## [Structural Equation Modeling Using R and Mplus](/books/sem/)

A practical introduction to structural equation modeling with worked examples in both R (`lavaan`) and Mplus. Covers measurement models, path analysis, latent variable models, model fit, and multi-group / multilevel extensions. Built around *ESC_PS 9710*, a doctoral course I taught at the University of Missouri. [Lecture slides →](/slides/sem/) · [Previous site →](https://zewang.netlify.app/books/sem/_book/)
